Coaches

Coaches Clinic with Deng. 28 and 29 December.

17 October 2026 · Talata Basketball

Two days on the floor for coaches from any club, at any level. Monday 28 and Tuesday 29 December, 09:15 to 15:00, at Hafnia-Hallen. It runs inside our December camp, so you learn it in the morning and coach it in the afternoon.

I lead both days. Jordan Naughton runs the camp floor, so you see every drill run with real players before you take it. On one day NBA and EuroLeague coaches join our coaches-only hour on a live video call.

The day

Coffee at 09:15. From 09:30 you are on the floor with the camp. Jordan runs the first block with the players while I take you through it, then you run a station yourself. After lunch you take a team of campers aged 13 to 17 in the camp games, with feedback after every game. The last hour is upstairs, coaches only.

Monday is testing, Tuesday is teaching. Wednesday 30 December is game day. Come back free and take your team again.

Seats and price

30 seats. 1.300 kr to Sunday 15 November, then 1.795 kr. Lunch both days. Your club can pay by invoice. To run a team you need a børneattest, and we request it after you book. English both days.

30 seats

Book before 15 November for the early price.
